name: Sleep deprivation
definition: Insufficient sleep that alters attention, emotion, and physical functioning.
mechanism: Reduced restorative sleep can impair cognitive control and increase sensitivity to stress.

name: Cognitive load
definition: The amount of mental effort required to process information and complete a task.
mechanism: High demands can consume limited working-memory resources and reduce decision quality.

name: Peer norms
definition: Shared expectations within a peer group about acceptable or typical behavior.
mechanism: People adjust behavior to gain approval, avoid sanctions, or follow perceived group practice.

name: Collective values
definition: Widely shared ideas about what a community considers important, desirable, or proper.
mechanism: Values shape how situations are interpreted and which actions are seen as legitimate.

name: Heat stress
definition: Exposure to heat that strains the body's ability to maintain a safe internal temperature.
mechanism: Thermal strain can produce fatigue, discomfort, and reduced physical or cognitive performance.

name: Organizational policy
definition: A formal rule or procedure that directs behavior within an organization.
mechanism: Policies change incentives, permissions, resources, and consequences attached to choices.

name: Information overload
definition: Exposure to more information than can be effectively processed or evaluated.
mechanism: Excess volume and competing signals make prioritization harder and can encourage shortcuts.

name: Recommendation systems
definition: Automated systems that select and rank content, products, or actions for a user.
mechanism: Ranking and personalization alter which options receive attention and repeated exposure.
